mentions.name: Vorbim
mentions.description: Free website for Russian speakers in Moldova to learn Romanian, using AI to generate lessons and exercises, AI text-to-speech for pronunciations, and AI-coded cards, backed by open-source word databases. A one-month project currently serving around 100 people daily.
mentions.audience: Russian-speaking people in Moldova who want to learn Romanian
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://vorbim.org/ - free AI generated website for russian speaking folks in Moldova to learn romanian.

AI to generate lessons, excercises
AI text to speech to make pronounciations
AI to code cards
open sources words dbs.

fun 1 month project. gets like 100ppl daily.

mentions.name: Vorbim
mentions.description: This app teaches Romanian online using a frequency-ranked Romanian word list, free open dictionary data from dexonline, and Google text-to-speech to turn words into audio. It runs on Cloudflare storage and a cheap Hetzner server, and was built with heavy AI assistance for content generation, design, and setup.
mentions.problem: Existing Romanian-learning websites are built for English speakers, so learners must start from English; the author's nieces in Moldova said there was no app to learn Romanian online.
mentions.audience: People learning Romanian online, including the author's nieces in Moldova
mentions.source_excerpt:
anyhow May 20th I sit down to "vibecode" an app - see what happens. 

one thing led to another and here we are

https://vorbim.org/

found some romanian words ranked by frequency. 
found free open db of romanian words on dexonline. 
found google TTS to transform text to sound.
